name: db-analysis
descriptionEn: Scope a dataset, run several read-only queries with consistent metric definitions, select charts, explain changes with evidence, and produce an HTML or PDF analysis report with source references.
descriptionZh: 面向企业业务库的图文数据分析能力包。SOP 为"圈数据集 → 多步取数 → 图表 → 结论 → 报告"：先用语义层表白名单 + 血缘 join 路径圈定数据集（模型不从全量表选表），再多步 取数且每步引用同一指标定义（版本 pin）、统一注入默认过滤与时间粒度，保证跨图跨步 口径一致；随后按数据形态自动匹配柱/线/饼/散点，提炼有数据支撑的归因结论，最终导出 含引用 chips 的 HTML/PDF 报告。以只读为主，审批模式默认 auto-edit。

pin.reason: 多步取数会产出多张图与多段结论；若各步各自解析口径，环比/同比/贡献度会出现 "同一指标不同算法"的自相矛盾。会话级 pin 后，升级只影响新会话，历史报告可复现。

approval_overrides.reason: 超大行数扫描（预估 > 5000 万行）
缺少时间范围过滤的全表聚合（分析多步取数更易放大该代价）
数据集过宽（>40 表）会显著降低 schema linking 与口径命中率
报告外发分享需确认脱敏范围与可见性
大批量导出（> 10 万行）需确认脱敏与落盘范围

recommended_questions.text: 生成 Walmart 销售分析报告
recommended_questions.text_en: Generate a Walmart sales analysis report
recommended_questions.title: 销售分析报告
recommended_questions.hint: 圈数据集→多步取数→图表→结论→报告
recommended_questions.hint_en: Scope the dataset, query, chart, draw conclusions, and report

recommended_questions.text: 分析本月华东区销售下滑的归因，出图文报告
recommended_questions.text_en: Explain this month's sales decline in East China and produce a visual report
recommended_questions.hint_en: Scope the dataset, pin valid_gmv@v2, and compare channel and category contributions
recommended_questions.hint: 数据集圈定 + valid_gmv@v2 pin + 渠道/品类贡献度拆解 + HTML 报告

recommended_questions.text: 对比华东华南近 12 周订单占比趋势
recommended_questions.text_en: Compare order share in East and South China over the last 12 weeks
recommended_questions.hint_en: Use consistent definitions, stacked bars, share trends, and evidence-based conclusions
recommended_questions.hint: 同一口径跨区对比，堆叠柱 + 占比折线 + 结论卡

recommended_questions.text: 近 30 天各品类 GMV Top10 及环比，生成周报
recommended_questions.text_en: Create a weekly report on the top 10 categories by GMV over the last 30 days
recommended_questions.hint_en: Use daily grain, ranking charts, month-over-month changes, and anomaly annotations
recommended_questions.hint: 时间粒度统一为日，Top10 榜单柱图 + 异动标注 + 周报

recommended_questions.text: 618 大促 ROI 归因，哪些渠道品类拉动了增量
recommended_questions.text_en: Analyze ROI for the June 18 promotion and identify channels and categories driving growth
recommended_questions.hint_en: Compare the promotion with a normal baseline and report incremental contributions
recommended_questions.hint: 大促 vs 日常基线，增量拆解 + 投入产出散点 + 报告
